title: PC 1201: General
officialText:
1201.1 Scope.

The provisions of this chapter shall govern the design and installation of piping and storage systems for nonflammable medical and nonmedical gas systems.

1201.2 Storage, handling, and use.

The storage, handling, and use of medical and nonmedical gases shall be in accordance with the New York City Fire Code.
